newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Stals says rand appreciation can be excessive.
newsitem.headline: Stals says rand appreciation can be excessive.

text.p: South African Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals said on Tuesday that an excessive appreciation in the rand could cause problems for the economy, just as last year's excessive fall had down.
Commenting on the currency's sharp new year rally, Stals said in an interview after a media briefing in Cape Town:
"It can become too much. Some of our exporters already adjusted themselves to the new level of the exchange rate. So just as a depreciation creates problems, so can appreciation also create problems.
"So we would not like to see the appreciation going on forever. But at this stage from an anti-inflationary point of view we welcome the development."

Stals, whose earlier remark that the rand may have over-adjusted slightly this year sent the currency sharply lower, said the authorities wanted to see some stabilisation but would not attempt to fix the rate artificially.
